t: Robot Safety Interlock Builder - public implementations survey
title: Robot Safety Interlock Builder - public implementations survey
definition: Implements defined conditions that prevent unsafe motion.
description:
Robot Safety Interlock Builder is one of the fundamental capabilities an AI needs to build things on demand: Implements defined conditions that prevent unsafe motion. In the real world this capability is delivered by a rich ecosystem of tools, libraries and platforms. This database is the public edition - a fact-checked survey of the real implementations, the real techniques they share, the standards they follow, and laddered drills that teach the capability hands-on.

No single tool owns Robot Safety Interlock Builder. Competing implementations emphasize different trade-offs: speed against flexibility, simplicity against power, integration against independence. The implementation spotlights in this database document the notable real ones - what each does, where it excels, and how it serves Robot Safety Interlock Builder. Together they map the territory as it actually exists.

Every record carries a runnable demonstration program, because tools are understood by use. Run the demos with node, compare the implementations, practice the drills, and the Robot Safety Interlock Builder capability becomes something you can reach for - with full knowledge of which real tool fits which job.

t: Foundation drill - name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Robot Safety Inte
title: Foundation drill - name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Robot Safety Inte
definition: Ladder drill (foundation): name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Robot Safety Interlock Builder from a one-paragraph brief.
description:
Drill (FOUNDATION): name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Robot Safety Interlock Builder from a one-paragraph brief

Read the brief twice. List every input the Robot Safety Interlock Builder needs, every output it must produce, and one contract each input-output pair must satisfy. Work it by hand first, then run the demo program and compare its trace against your own reasoning. When they agree, the concept is yours.

Success criterion: you can list them from memory without looking at the brief
